德光母 continues 德光之母 from the previous sentence; the speaker is Deguang’s mother, not Empress Dowager Deguang.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 德光母曰：「留此人中原，何失策之甚！」

decisions.reason: The literal line again attaches an empress-dowager title to Deguang; 德光母 is his mother.

The literal line repeats the fused Zihua for 梓滑二州.

claimRetractions.reason: The aristocrat role was inferred from English “Prince Wang Yin”; 王殷 is the personal name Wang Yin, and 王 is the surname, not a princely title.
The consort role was inferred from English “Empress Dowager Deguang”; the Chinese only names 德光之母, Deguang’s mother, without a consort title.

claimRevisions.reason: The extracted English personal name Yang Ye was produced by the mistranslation of 楊邠; the Chinese supports Yang Bin.
The extracted English label Empress Dowager Deguang misreads 德光之母; the source names her as Deguang’s mother.
德光母 continues 德光之母; the English Empress Dowager Deguang is a translation artifact, not a source title.
守太保 is honorary Grand Guardian (太保), not Grand Preceptor (太師); the office label followed the unrepaired English.
